{{Top|leg}}
A '''Communicator mini-droid''', also referred to as a '''CmD''', was a [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]] in a case with a keyboard attached. They could interface with other [[Computer/Legends|computers]] and [[Droid/Legends|droids]], transmit and receive data and [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]], and access secured doors.
